song.title: Are You Gonna Go My Way

purpose: One new reference-blind CPU front-end experiment after V154 failed its frozen acoustic-recognition gates. V155 changes both timebase architecture and pitch-recognition architecture; it is not a threshold sweep or correction of V154.

timebase.principle: Musical time is derived from audio; audio timestamp 0 is never assumed to be musical grid step 0.
timebase.beatTracker: librosa.beat.beat_track on deterministic multi-band onset envelope derived from normalized mix plus separated drums
timebase.tempoMode: dynamic beat times; do not force one constant BPM for event mapping

downbeatPhase.selection: choose the deterministic beat-phase index maximizing beat-synchronous accent evidence from low-frequency onset energy, drums onset energy, and full-band spectral flux

timebase.leadingGrid: after phase selection, extrapolate beat intervals backward only as needed so the first musical event can map before the first detected beat; do not use any professional-reference anchor
timebase.eventMapping: piecewise-linear interpolation between detected beat times; each beat spans 4 sixteenth-grid steps; outside tracked range use nearest robust local beat period
timebase.quantization: map raw onset to fractional sixteenth position then deterministically snap to nearest integer sixteenth for scorer-facing measure/step; preserve raw seconds and unsnapped grid position in debug metadata

bassRecognition.onsetDetection: librosa.onset.onset_detect with backtrack=true and fixed default normalization
bassRecognition.segmentation: split on detected onset, voiced/unvoiced transition, or stable-pitch change >= 0.70 semitone sustained for >= 3 frames
bassRecognition.pitchAssignment: median voiced MIDI per segment, rounded to nearest MIDI semitone
bassRecognition.repeatedSamePitch: retain distinct same-pitch notes when a new detected onset occurs

guitarRecognition.architecture: polyphonic model plus independent harmonic-CQT evidence

cqt.signal: HPSS harmonic component of guitar stem
cqt.salience: local log-magnitude peak energy accumulated within +/- one third semitone around each MIDI center
cqt.highConfidencePeak: salience >= median + 3.0*MAD and local maximum in pitch
cqt.onsetEvidence: positive salience flux at the candidate MIDI plus guitar onset envelope

fusion.basicPitchRetention: retain a Basic Pitch event when its MIDI has CQT support at onset or over at least 35% of its first 120 ms; exceptionally strong Basic Pitch events with amplitude >= 0.80 are retained without CQT veto
fusion.cqtOnlyCompletion: at detected guitar onsets, add a CQT-only MIDI only when it is a high-confidence peak, has onset evidence, is not a likely harmonic duplicate of a stronger lower fundamental, and is not within 60 ms of an already-kept same-MIDI event

postProcessing.deduplicateSameStream: same MIDI and same snapped grid step collapse to one event; retain strongest evidence and provenance

mustPassBeforeFreeze: all events finite and inside frozen MIDI ranges
no professional-reference path imported or opened

failurePolicy: If V155 misses a frozen gate, freeze the failure, diagnose architecture, and move to a new version. Never retune or select a replacement V155 candidate against the professional reference.
